name: BCAL Diagnostics Limited
summary: BCAL Diagnostics Limited is a biotechnology company developing a non-surgical laboratory blood test for breast cancer. Its BCAL test is a lipid biomarker-based assay intended for prevention, early screening and patient monitoring, working by detecting a pattern of lipid biomarkers from extracellular vesicles in plasma or blood. It was established in 2010 and has its base in Sydney.
